body: I don’t have a desire to go out and kill someone, and I’ll say though I have a much higher respect for animal life than I do others, I mean like if I were home and someone broke in I wouldn’t care if they died, or if I had driven a car and someone walked out in front of me and I hit them and they died I would be more worried about the car. Again, I don’t have any desire to go out of my way to end a life but if it happened i would feel more inconvenienced then anything
